reasons: Draft claims 'Renamed the Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science in September 2026 following a $3 billion gift' but source states renaming occurred 'On September 30, 2026' with '$3 billion donation... including $500 million designated for the school' — date and allocation specifics differ
Draft states 'thirteen Turing Award winners among its alumni and staff' while source says 'thirteen SCS faculty and alumni have won' — 'staff' vs 'faculty' is a material distinction

Draft claims 'seven departments including Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, and Human-Computer Interaction' but source lists seven departments with different names: 'Ray and Stephanie Lane Computational Biology Department', 'Computer Science Department', 'Human–Computer Interaction Institute', 'Software and Societal Systems Department', 'Language Technologies Institute', 'Machine Learning Department', 'Robotics Institute' — department names are inaccurate
Draft states 'Mobot Races... now in their 14th year' but source citation shows 'now in their 14th year' with no publication date — cannot verify currency
Draft summary includes 'Planetary Robotics Center' as part of Gates and Hillman Centers but source says 'including... the Planetary Robotics Center' — ambiguous whether it's housed there or separate
